{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types
dtypes = trial_df.dtypes

# Check unique values in the 'disease_severity' column
disease_severity_unique = trial_df['disease_severity'].unique()

# Check the distribution of disease severity
severity_counts = trial_df['disease_severity'].value_counts()

# Print results
print("Missing values:\n", missing_values)
print("\nData types:\n", dtypes)
print("\nUnique values in disease_severity:\n", disease_severity_unique)
print("\nDistribution of disease_severity:\n", severity_counts)"}
